tests.description: Hovering CameraBar opens the CameraView layer, and hovering it again (after leaving) closes it.
tests.name: Hovering the camera bar toggles the camera view
source: // Keep the cursor away from the camera bar from the very first frame: hovering it is what toggles the camera view.
// The bar toggles once per hover: leave it, then come back on it.
harness.assert(afterHover !== before, 'Hovering CameraBar toggled the CameraView layer visibility (' + before + ' -> ' + afterHover + ')');
harness.assert(afterSecond === before, 'Hovering again toggled the CameraView layer back (' + afterHover + ' -> ' + afterSecond + ')');

tests.description: RemainingPower decreases over time, the percentage text updates, and drains faster while the camera view is open.
tests.name: Power drains over time and drains faster with camera open
source: // Keep the cursor away from the camera bar from the very first frame: hovering it is what toggles the camera view.
// The bar toggles once per hover: leave it, then come back on it.
// The power drains with the game time, so step 50ms frames (the longest the game accepts, minFPS is 20) and measure over a few of them: CI renders in software and a frame is slow there.
console.log('Idle drain over ' + WINDOW_FRAMES + ' frames: ' + idleDrain);
harness.assert(!!text && String(text.text).includes('%'), 'Power percentage text displayed: ' + (text && text.text));
console.log('Camera drain over ' + WINDOW_FRAMES + ' frames: ' + camDrain);
harness.assert(camDrain > idleDrain * 1.5, 'Power drains faster with camera open (' + camDrain + ' vs ' + idleDrain + ')');

* These are hard limits rather than performance trade-offs. three.js binds one
* texture unit per shadow map and one more for a spot light's projected
* texture, and spends a varying on every shadow casting light. Going over what
* the driver allows does not make the scene slower - the shader fails to link
* and everything using that material renders black. Only 16 fragment texture

* of those, so the budget is read from the device instead of being fixed.
* The budget is shared between the light kinds a scene uses, so it is given
